data.name: Ameel
data.gender_notes: Ameel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ameel is an Arabic name that means 'river'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'amal' which means 'work'. In the context of a name, Ameel signifies a person who is constantly working towards achieving his goals. The name Ameel carries the meaning “River” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Ameel usually hope their child will grow to embody river and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ameel is a name that signifies the constant flow of life and the journey towards self-improvement and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Ameel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “River.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ameel total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أميل
in_arabic.meaning: أميل يعني الموكل أو العامل أو الشخص المسؤول عن شيء ما
in_arabic.long_meaning: أميل هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-م-ل' والذي يعني العمل أو القيام بشيء ما. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم 'أميل' للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتم تعيينه أو تكليفه لتنفيذ عمل معين أو إدارة شؤون محددة. كما يمكن أن يشير إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بالقدرة على العمل بجد واجتهاد. في بعض الأحيان، يُربط هذا الاسم بالموكل أو العامل الذي يتحمل مسؤولية معينة.

in_urdu.name: امیਲ
in_urdu.meaning: امیلی مطلب ہے ایجنٹ، عامل، یا کسی چیز کا ذمہ دار شخص

in_hindi.name: अमील
in_hindi.meaning: अमील का अर्थ है एजेंट, कारक, या किसी चीज़ का ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति

in_english.name: Ameel

in_english.long_meaning: The name Ameel is derived from the Arabic root 'ع-م-ل' (ʿ-m-l), which means 'to work' or 'to do'. This name is found in various Muslim cultures and is often associated with diligence, responsibility, and reliability. Etymologically, it shares connections with Quranic terms related to deeds and actions, emphasizing the importance of work and accountability in Islam.
